purpose: Locate the high-memory source words consumed by the state-dependent GSP FILL XY geometry path.

observations.FFF45A10: Runtime instruction is MOVE *A5+,A7,1; the filtered reads return 16-bit source words from dynamic GSP high memory.
observations.FFF45A40: Runtime instruction is MOVE *A5+,A9,1; it consumes the adjacent source stream used for the second FILL XY coordinate.
observations.input_dependence: The identical save-state forks select different source-address streams and read counts before the same endpoint frame.
observations.instruction_fetch_caveat: The read tap also reports the instruction fetch at the filtered PC; data-read counts remove only events whose address equals that PC.

interpretation: The FILL XY path is fed by dynamic GSP work-RAM records rather than directly by the sampled palette or fixed display registers. This narrows the next producer task to the GSP high-memory record writer/source format, but does not yet assign roadway, object, or HUD semantics to the records.
